Decision reference missing: Single linear state machine (C1) enforces strict stage ordering with no parallel lanes, eliminating merge-conflict risk and simplifying checkpoint/resume.
Decision reference missing: Big-bang milestone: one freeze event at the end; no partial freezes or incremental releases.

Decision reference missing: High HITL strictness: every ChangeRequest, forbidden-path touch, secrets detection, gate waiver, retry-budget exhaustion, and permission expansion triggers mandatory human review.

Decision reference missing: Writer/Reviewer/Judge separation enforced by orchestrator output-type allowlists and multi-vendor routing constraints (C5 writers, C7 reviewers findings-only, C9 judges decisions-only).

Decision reference missing: All repairs via RFC 6902 JSON Patch (JSON artifacts) or replacement diff-only patchsets (code), with deterministic smallest-passing-repair selection (fewest ops → fewest bytes → first-generated).
Decision reference missing: Context packs compiled deterministically by C1 per stage from workspace_index with explicit selection rules and bounded size.
Decision reference missing: Secrets scanning at every checkpoint and pre-freeze; blocking persistence of any detected secret.

Decision reference missing: Workspace governed via C2 with canonical vs non-canonical separation, append-only non-canonical notes, versioned canonical artifacts, and workspace_index.json completeness validation.
Decision reference missing: Tool permission matrix enforced per stage with deny-by-default, network-deny baseline, repo-write only via patch_apply in designated stages.
Decision reference missing: Sandboxed tooling level with all tool invocations scoped to declared entrypoints in repo_context.json.
